context: Ren visits a publisher's editing office; meets with the editor.
purpose: Young writer in professional editorial visit.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 社長、執筆の進み、ご報告します。
lines.en: Sir, I wanted to give you an update on the writing progress.
lines.style: Steady, careful opening. Respectful but not stiff—a young man speaking to someone he trusts. Measured pace, slight pause before the main point, like he's organized his thoughts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん、毎月、見直してるんやな。
lines.en: Yeah, so you're reviewing this every month then.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, slightly leading. Nodding into the conversation. Genuinely interested—not interrogating, just checking his understanding. Light and grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 改良点、いくつも、見つかりました。
lines.en: I found quite a few areas where we could improve.
lines.style: Earnest and precise. A slight lift on 'quite a few'—not complaint, but clarity. Quiet confidence underneath. He's done the work and he knows it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 前作と比較、位置づけ、はっきり。
lines.en: Compared to the previous one, this positioning is much clearer.
lines.style: Nod of recognition. Strategic, slightly appreciative—he sees what Ren's done. Calm voice, the kind that carries weight without pushing. Quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 共感の場面、創作で、強化したい。
lines.en: I'd like to strengthen the scenes where the characters really connect—make them more powerful.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly in the voice. Real conviction here—this matters to him beyond the project. Warm but focused, like he's inviting agreement on something he believes in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: I believe in what you can do.
lines.style: Short, steady, direct. No performance—just a fact stated quietly. The kind of statement that lands because it's clear and unadorned. Warm underneath the simplicity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、励みになります。
lines.en: Thank you, sir. That really does encourage me.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, genuine. Not effusive—he means it simply. Slight warmth on 'really,' like it's settling into him. Respectful close, but not distant.
